name: Four Seasons Resort Palm Beach
positioning: Oceanfront resort at 2800 South Ocean Boulevard on Palm Beach Island, on the Atlantic Ocean
best_for: Travelers who want an oceanfront resort with direct beach access
Families who want a complimentary kids program

facts.text: The resort has 207 rooms in total.
The resort has 193 guest rooms and 14 suites.
The resort is at 2800 South Ocean Boulevard in Palm Beach.
The resort is located on Palm Beach Island's most beautiful, expansive beach along the Atlantic Ocean.
Martin Brudnizki is the interior designer of the resort.
The signature restaurant is Florie's by Mauro Colagrecco.
Seaway is a seaside restaurant serving a seafood menu rooted in ingredients indigenous to South Florida, with a hint of Latin flair.
The resort has two pools, including an adult-only option.

highlights.text: Florie's delivers the spirit of the Mediterranean through live fire cooking and earth-conscious offerings inspired by nature.
Both pools have stunning 180-degree views of the Atlantic Ocean.
The Spa's relaxation areas, eucalyptus steam room and saltwater whirlpool are complimentary to access.
The Kids For All Seasons program is complimentary and runs daily.
Ocean-View Cabana Terrace Rooms are first-floor rooms with private and direct access to the pool and the ocean.

considerations.text: The resort is within short driving distance of Worth Avenue shopping.
Children aged 12 to 17 who wish to use the Spa's facilities must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
